title: SoA Table Corrections Schema
description: Human corrections to a raw soa-table-extraction. The raw extraction is immutable; corrections here are applied to produce the verified extraction that feeds resolution. Each correction is source-linked and self-describing, so the corrections corpus doubles as a provenance record and a feedback dataset for extraction-prompt refinement.

schema_version.description: Schema version. 1.1 adds ops 'add_item' and 'remove_item' with 'field' and 'value'; files stamped 1.0 remain valid.

target_extraction.description: Filename of the raw extraction JSON this sidecar corrects.

id.description: Correction identifier, unique within this file (e.g. 'corr-001').

target.description: Which extraction array this correction acts on. 'table_metadata' is the one object, not an array: it takes op 'set' without 'match', and 'table_number' cannot be set.

op.description: add=append 'set' as a new entry; set=update the single entry matching 'match'; remove=drop entries matching 'match'; confirm=change nothing - records that the reviewer examined the review item named in 'review_item' and kept the call (requires 'review_item'; no 'match' or 'set'); add_item=append 'value' to the array-valued field named in 'field' of the single entry matching 'match'; remove_item=drop from that array the one element equal to 'value' (an error if it is not there exactly once). Both require 'field' and 'value' and take no 'set'.

match.description: Key fields locating the target entry (e.g. table_number/row_position/column_position). Required for 'set', 'remove', 'add_item' and 'remove_item'; omit for 'add'.

set.description: Field values to write. For 'add', the full new entry; for 'set', the fields to update. Omit for 'remove'.

field.description: For 'add_item' and 'remove_item': name of the array-valued field of the matched entry (e.g. 'marker_locations').

value.description: For 'add_item' and 'remove_item': the one array element to append or to drop, written in full (compared as a whole, not field by field).

reason.description: Human explanation of why this correction was made.

source_ref.description: Where in the source document this correction is grounded, for audit back to source.

row_position.description: Row position in the table, as in the extraction.

column_position.description: Column position in the table, as in the extraction.

cell_value.description: The cell content as printed in the source.

review_item.description: Id of the extraction's review_items entry this correction answers. An item is decided exactly when some correction in this file names it: with op 'confirm' the call stands, with any other op this correction is the alternative taken. Absent on corrections that are not answers to a review item.

corrections.description: The corrections, one entry per change or confirmation.
